answer: Agents may wander a marketplace trading anything from quill pens to umber pigment, but each identity must lock 100 tokens for 30 days to receive a fixed daily request quota. Creating more public keys earns no extra quota until each key posts its own deposit. An attacker seeking 1,000 identities must therefore immobilize 100,000 tokens for a month, making a sybil swarm consume capital in direct proportion to its size.
